basic_details.job_title: SVSU Skill Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Shri Vishwakarma Skill University (SVSU), Palwal, Haryana, has invited applications for 10 posts of Skill Assistant Professor (Computer Science & Engg./IT) under Advt No. SVSU/2026/Estt./T-60. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 11 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online only at https://forms.eduqfix.com/svsurectff/add; payment slip to be enclosed with application.

age_limit.age_details: As per UGC norms (retirement age 60 years) (as on last date of receipt of application)

qualification.education_qualification: B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in relevant branch with first class or equivalent in any one of the degrees; OR Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering along with MCA, with the existing AICTE qualifications for Assistant Professor in Engineering and Technology.
qualification.details: Qualification: B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in relevant branch with first class or equivalent in any one of the Degrees; OR Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering along with MCA, along with existing qualifications as prescribed by AICTE for Assistant Professor in Engineering and Technology Age limit: As per UGC norms (retirement age 60 years) (as on last date of receipt of application) | Other conditions: | Must be a citizen of India Must have knowledge of Hindi/Sanskrit as one of the subjects at matric or higher level Qualifications obtained through distance mode are not admissible for teaching posts in Science and Technology Reserved category applicants from outside Haryana are considered under UR category only Qualification and experience determined as on the last date of receipt of application Valid personal mobile number and email ID required till the process ends | Desirable: | Good knowledge of computer applications will be preferred

salary_details.pay_scale: Academic Pay Level APL-10 as per 7th CPC

exam_pattern.details: Written test marks shown individually through applicant login; objections invited by displaying question paper and key on University website Scribe or compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour for eligible PwBD candidates

how_to_apply: Pay the application fee online at https://forms.eduqfix.com/svsurectff/add.
Fill the offline application form (Part A and Part B) attached to the advertisement.
Enclose the fee payment slip and all self-attested, page-numbered supporting documents.
Write on the sealed envelope: Application for the post of (Name of the post) against (Advt. No.).
Send to The Assistant Registrar (Estt.), Takshashila Bhawan (Admin Block), Shri Vishwakarma Skill University, Dudhola, Palwal, Haryana-121102 by 11.12.2026, 05:00 PM.
Employees in permanent government service apply through proper channel and send an advance copy directly.
important_instructions: Separate application with separate fee and documents for each post applied for Permanent government employees must apply through proper channel and send an advance copy; NOC (Annexure-H) at interview No TA/DA for attending written/skill test, presentation or interview Posts will be re-advertised if recruitment is not completed within six months Updates, test/interview dates and shortlists only on the University website, not in newspapers Disputes fall within the jurisdiction of Palwal Court only

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Last date: 11 December 2026 Vacancies: 10 How to apply: Offline, by post or in person as the notification says Fee: Male candidates of Gen. category including DESM of Haryana; Male/Female candidates of General category and all reserved categories of other states: Rs. 1000; All Female candidates of Gen. category including Female DESM of Haryana only: Rs. 250; Male and Female candidates of DSC/OSC/BCA/BCB/ESM/EWS categories of Haryana only: Rs. 250 Pay: Academic Pay Level APL-10 as per 7th CPC Age limit: As per UGC norms (retirement age 60 years) (as on last date of receipt of application) Place: Shri Vishwakarma Skill University, Dudhola, Palwal, Haryana

content_sections.heading: SVSU Skill Assistant Professor (Computer Science & Engg./IT) Recruitment 2026 - Overview

rows.shri_vishwakarma_skill_university_svsu_p: Academic Pay Level APL-10 as per 7th CPC
Shri Vishwakarma Skill University, Dudhola, Palwal, Haryana

B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in relevant branch with first class or equivalent in any one of the degrees; OR Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering along with MCA, with the existing AICTE qualifications for Assistant Professor in Engineering and Technology.
As per UGC norms (retirement age 60 years) (as on last date of receipt of application)
The Assistant Registrar (Estt.), Takshashila Bhawan (Admin Block), Shri Vishwakarma Skill University, Dudhola, Palwal, Haryana-121102

content_sections.heading: SVSU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. SVSU/2026/Estt./T-60 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download SVSU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in relevant branch with first class or equivalent in any one of the Degrees; OR Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering along with MCA, along with existing qualifications as prescribed by AICTE for Assistant Professor in Engineering and Technology Age limit: As per UGC norms (retirement age 60 years) (as on last date of receipt of application) Other conditions: Must be a citizen of India Must have knowledge of Hindi/Sanskrit as one of the subjects at matric or higher level Qualifications obtained through distance mode are not admissible for teaching posts in Science and Technology Reserved category applicants from outside Haryana are considered under UR category only Qualification and experience determined as on the last date of receipt of application Valid personal mobile number and email ID required till the process ends Desirable: Good knowledge of computer applications will be preferred

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for SVSU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Persons convicted by any court of law or with criminal proceedings pending Persons of unsound mind and questionable conduct or not medically fit to perform duties Persons who married a person having a living spouse (exemption possible by Competent Authority) Any person disqualified for appointment by Govt. of India/State Govt./UGC Holders of qualifications from fake or unrecognised Board/University/Institution

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Posts are on regular basis Age of retirement is 60 years as per University rules

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online only at https://forms.eduqfix.com/svsurectff/add; payment slip to be enclosed with application.

content_sections.heading: How Will SVSU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written Test (50 marks) Teaching Skills (30 marks) Interview (20 marks) Written test: minimum 40% to qualify; 38% for DSC/OSC/BC/PWD candidates All applicants may appear in the written test without eligibility check; only qualifiers are scrutinised Shortlisting by academic record score as per Annexure-B Final selection on Written Test 50, Teaching Skills 30 and Interview 20 marks Test structure and syllabus to be uploaded on the University website

content_sections.heading: SVSU Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Written test marks shown individually through applicant login; objections invited by displaying question paper and key on University website Scribe or compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour for eligible PwBD candidates

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Online fee payment slip Self-attested, page-numbered copies of certificates and testimonials CGPA-to-marks conversion document or table of equivalence from the university Latest reservation certificates in prescribed format (Haryana) Proof of journal status and legible copies of claimed research papers Ph.D. certificate (Annexure-C or D) and experience certificate with salary proof (Annexure-G)

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Separate application with separate fee and documents for each post applied for Permanent government employees must apply through proper channel and send an advance copy; NOC (Annexure-H) at interview No TA/DA for attending written/skill test, presentation or interview Posts will be re-advertised if recruitment is not completed within six months Updates, test/interview dates and shortlists only on the University website, not in newspapers Disputes fall within the jurisdiction of Palwal Court only

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SVSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SVSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies for Skill Assistant Professor (Computer Science & Engg./IT).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SVSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application Form (Part A and Part B) attached at the end of the advertisement PDF) and send it to The Assistant Registrar (Estt.), Takshashila Bhawan (Admin Block), Shri Vishwakarma Skill University, Dudhola, Palwal, Haryana-121102, by in sealed envelope to the postal address; no application entertained after the last date due to postal delay, to reach by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Male candidates of Gen. category including DESM of Haryana; Male/Female candidates of General category and all reserved categories of other states: Rs. 1000. All Female candidates of Gen. category including Female DESM of Haryana only: Rs. 250. Male and Female candidates of DSC/OSC/BCA/BCB/ESM/EWS categories of Haryana only: Rs. 250. Persons with disabilities (at least 40% or more disability) of Haryana only: Nil.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Academic Pay Level APL-10 as per 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in relevant branch with first class or equivalent in any one of the degrees; OR Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering along with MCA, with the existing AICTE qualifications for Assistant Professor in Engineering and Technology.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a citizen of India. Must have knowledge of Hindi/Sanskrit as one of the subjects at matric or higher level. Qualifications obtained through distance mode are not admissible for teaching posts in Science and Technology. Reserved category applicants from outside Haryana are considered under UR category only.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons convicted by any court of law or with criminal proceedings pending. Persons of unsound mind and questionable conduct or not medically fit to perform duties. Persons who married a person having a living spouse (exemption possible by Competent Authority). Any person disqualified for appointment by Govt. of India/State Govt./UGC.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written Test (50 marks). Teaching Skills (30 marks). Interview (20 marks). Written test: minimum 40% to qualify; 38% for DSC/OSC/BC/PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts are on regular basis. Age of retirement is 60 years as per University rules.
